articles.summary: We are on the cusp of a new era in transportation. Autonomous vehicles are no longer just a concept — they are being deployed in trucking, passenger mobility, agriculture, and mining, paving the way for a safer, more efficient future. Aurora’s plans to deploy self-driving trucks onto public roads in Texas will bring the benefits of autonomy directly to our supply chain and economy. We believe introducing this new technology will create economic value for our customers and improve road safety...
